RagShortTexts: Tērvete is linked to Semigallian local power.
Defence requires stores, labor and partners.

Variants.Content: Tērvete’s defence draws on its strongpoint, nearby harvests and cooperating chiefs. Concentration adds defenders but also food and shelter needs. Repairs, warnings and contact with neighbors require advance preparation.
Tērvete needs repairers, watchers and carriers as well as fighters. Promised aid cannot fill a daily shortage unless it reaches the approaches.
Aid requests specify food and hosting capacity. A shared enemy does not create unlimited supplies; protecting nearby harvests supports endurance.
Nearby families supply the post and seek shelter. Dependants arriving with them need food and room; unequal allocation creates anger before fighting begins.
